title: 944. Check Completeness of a Binary Tree

examples.explanation: Every level is full, so the tree satisfies the completeness rule.
Node 3 is missing its left child yet has a right child 7, which breaks left-alignment.
The root lacks a left child while holding a right child, so the tree is incomplete.
